**Solution:**

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: multi-pod
  namespace: exam-q8
spec:
  volumes:
    - name: log-volume
      emptyDir: {}
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: busybox:1.36
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - 'while true; do echo "$(date) - Main app running" >> /var/log/app.log; sleep 5; done'
      volumeMounts:
        - name: log-volume
          mountPath: /var/log
    - name: logger
      image: busybox:1.36
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - 'tail -f /var/log/app.log'
      volumeMounts:
        - name: log-volume
          mountPath: /var/log
```

**Verification:**

```bash
k -n exam-q8 logs multi-pod -c logger
# Should see timestamped log lines
```

---

Volume mounted at /var/log in both containers

      emptyDir: {}
    - name: run
